source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Enter BMC-Web -> click "Health", and chck that it should access to "Event logs".

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL pretty-printed JSON from /redfish/v1/Chassis/system (Health/thermal/power readout) so user confirms the BMC web "health status" page shows the correct data. No RISK (read-only).

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES proposes a read-only Chassis JSON GET, but that does not click the BMC web `Health` icon or prove navigation to `Event logs`. It changes the target from UI link routing to chassis health/thermal/power data, uses insecure TLS/visible credentials and labels the mismatch no-risk.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED correctly restores browser navigation, identity binding and preservation of event logs. It additionally suggests UI/API data correlation; this review treats such correlation as optional supporting evidence because the source acceptance is specifically the icon/link route.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 845/2291 accepts the curl command despite the purpose mismatch and only defers syntax validation; no browser click, route, DOM or navigation error is evidenced.
historical_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No sequence-1008 draft exists in the invalidated 1,000-record run.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-34 treats browser/account/route data as readiness rather than permanent blockage; ED-35 preserves the source UI method and rejects an API-only substitution; ED-38 requires protected credentials, no DUT verdict and no automatic retry.

original_test_intent: Verify the `Health` icon/link in the authenticated BMC web UI is present, enabled and navigates exactly once to the intended `Event logs` view, which finishes rendering without navigation, permission or application errors.
original_method: Bind the exact BMC/web build and approved account, open a clean authenticated browser session, record the current route and Health control metadata, activate the Health icon once, verify the destination route/view identity and usable rendered state, then confirm no event-log or BMC state was cleared, acknowledged or changed.
manual_activity: An engineer supplies the target UI build/account and expected Health-to-Event-logs route or page identity. After that confirmation, browser automation can execute and evaluate the read-only link test; the engineer owns any visual ambiguity and formal verdict.
required_inputs: Immutable BMC identity, trusted web URL/certificate, firmware and UI build/version
Supported browser/version, viewport, page-load and single-page-application idle criteria, proxy/cache policy and isolated authenticated test profile
Approved read-only account/role and protected credentials/cookies, plus whether the Health control is visible for that role
Authoritative Health icon accessible name/selector/location and expected Event logs URL/route, title, heading or DOM landmark
Allowed redirect chain, expected empty/loading/error states, timeout and whether opening a new tab/window is valid
Evidence redaction rules and explicit prohibition on clear/acknowledge/delete actions
safety_requirements: Do not replace the browser click with `/redfish/v1/Chassis/system`; chassis health data does not test the source's icon/link navigation. API reads may bind identity or support diagnosis only.
Validate the BMC endpoint/certificate/build before login and use protected secret/session handling; never use `curl -k`, expose credentials/cookies or capture sensitive event details unnecessarily.
Click only the verified `Health` navigation control once. Do not click nearby clear, acknowledge, delete, export-with-side-effects or power controls.
Do not clear dmesg, syslog, SEL or BMC event logs before the test; preserving existing data helps confirm the Event logs view and avoids destructive evidence loss.
Do not accept mere clickability, URL change or HTTP 200 alone. Require the correct Event logs route/view identity and completion without blank page, error banner, permission denial or stuck loading.
Do not require health-field/API parity unless Project SPEC adds it; adding data correctness as a mandatory checkpoint would expand the source beyond `Icon link should be workable`.
Do not automatically retry a failed click/navigation, because repeated actions can mask transient routing defects; preserve first-failure screenshot, DOM, console and network evidence.
agent_execution_scope: Before approval, verify endpoint/build/account identity, locate the Health control by stable accessible/DOM attributes and capture the current route without activating it.

After approval, click the exact control once, wait using the approved navigation/SPA-idle rule and capture route transition, redirects, response/status, page title/heading/landmark and rendered state.
Check for console exceptions, failed navigation requests, access-denied/error/loading states and confirm no log mutation control was invoked; collect redacted screenshots/DOM/network evidence.
Optionally read a vendor-approved event-log resource only to bind the destination or diagnose mismatch, not as substitute acceptance; close the session and report facts without DUT verdict or retry.
engineer_actions: Approve the BMC/UI build, account role, Health selector and exact Event logs destination/acceptance markers.
Decide any ambiguous visual state or Project-added API correlation and confirm the evidence redaction scope.
Review first-attempt navigation evidence and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The GET is read-only but does not exercise the UI control or destination and therefore cannot satisfy the source. Its assumed `/Chassis/system` member, `-k`, visible basic-auth form and full JSON return are also not safe generic execution guidance.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use supported browser automation against the trusted BMC UI: authenticate through protected input, locate the Health link, click once, assert the approved Event logs route/DOM landmark and absence of navigation errors, and capture redacted UI/console/network evidence without mutating logs.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Health icon, Event logs destination, workable-link criterion, no Script and 5/0-minute estimates remain unmodified.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Identity/account preflight; stable Health-control discovery; one click; route and rendered Event logs assertion; error/permission/loading checks; no-mutation verification and redacted evidence.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BMC firmware/UI build and account role exposing the Health navigation control.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC/UI build, browser/version and the route/selector contract used.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project/vendor BMC web navigation map and access-control specification; API schema only as optional supporting context.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes `workable` measurable through route, DOM and error evidence while preserving the source's browser method and narrow scope.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Chassis JSON does not prove the icon; icon presence does not prove navigation; URL change without a rendered destination is incomplete; Event-log content correctness is separate unless Project SPEC requires it.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Endpoint/build, browser/account, selector, destination markers, timeout and evidence rules.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Selectors and SPA routes vary by build; role permissions may hide the icon; screenshots may expose event details even though the action is read-only.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may approve a build-specific selector or route and optional API correlation, but an API-only call is not equivalent to the source UI coverage. Record original versus actual interface, reason, approval and any unverified icon/navigation behavior.
expected_evidence: BMC endpoint/certificate identity, firmware/UI build, browser/version and redacted authenticated account role
Pre-click page route plus Health control screenshot/DOM accessible name, selector, enabled/visible state and target attribute if present
Single click timestamp, redirect/navigation chain and final URL/SPA route
Rendered Event logs page title/heading/landmark, loading completion and absence of blank, permission-denied or application-error state
Redacted screenshot/DOM plus browser console/network failures, proof no clear/acknowledge/delete action occurred and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria coherently define a Health UI icon whose expected destination is Event logs and whose acceptance is workable navigation. The label-to-destination relationship is unusual but explicit rather than contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The control, action and destination are understandable. The exact build, selector, route, account and browser are supplyable execution inputs, so the case requires package/user confirmation rather than being semantically blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Changes its API-only YES conclusion to a browser/package gate and rejects Chassis JSON as acceptance evidence for the UI link.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on package/user confirmation, browser navigation, identity and log preservation; narrows mandatory acceptance to the source link/destination while keeping API comparison optional.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Replaces command-presence sanity with exact UI control, route, rendered-state and first-failure evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No prior invalid draft exists for this sequence.

review_improvement: Prevents an unrelated read-only chassis query—or an icon that merely appears clickable—from being reported as successful Health-to-Event-logs navigation.
independent_technical_reasoning: The sole criterion is UI linkage, so the browser control and routing/rendering state are the system under test. Redfish chassis data cannot exercise that path, and expanding the case into health-data correctness would also distort coverage. A deterministic DOM/route assertion is automatable, but browser tooling, protected account and build-specific selectors must be supplied and confirmed.
